about_short_description.short_description: Ibnsina Pharma is a pharmaceutical distribution company.

product.name: Pharmaceutical Distribution
product.description: Distribution of pharmaceutical and cosmetic products from multiple manufacturers to pharmacies and hospitals nationwide.

product.name: Warehousing and Logistics
product.description: Storage and logistics management for pharmaceutical products, including temperature-controlled handling.

product.name: Order Taking and Delivery
product.description: Order processing and delivery services with extended branch hours and rapid response to customer inquiries.

product.name: Importation and Packaging
product.description: Importing pharmaceutical products and medical devices from multinational companies and packaging them for distribution.

product.name: Dedicated Sales Team
product.description: Sales team services that work with suppliers to target clients, launch products, and manage promotions.

product.name: Marketing Solutions
product.description: Marketing services to support suppliers in brand management and product promotion through advertising campaigns.
